cases.name: offer-three-scenarios
cases.description: 50,000 options at a $0.40 strike on 10,000,000 fully diluted shares. Downside ($3,000,000 exit, no further dilution): $0.30 per share is under water, net $0. Base ($100,000,000, 20% further dilution): 12,500,000 shares at exit, $8.00 per share, gross $400,000 minus $20,000 exercise cost = $380,000. Upside ($1,000,000,000, 33% further dilution): $67.00 per share, net $3,330,000.
cases.source: Holloway Guide to Equity Compensation and Index Ventures "Rewarding Talent" conventions; every number hand-derived in lib/openstartup/__tests__/equityComp.test.ts
